instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the hero background matches #0C2340 exactly.
Use #FFDAB9 (Peach) for primary CTA 'Bekijk mijn werk' with dark text (#0C2340).
Use #87CEEB (Sky Blue) for secondary outline CTA 'Neem contact op' and tech tag backgrounds.
Keep literal name '[Jouw Naam]' as requested in problem statement with options to personalize.
Implement working contact form with Sonner toast feedback and input state validation.
Section 'Over Mij' must have light background #F5F5F5 with two-column layout and manifesto chapters.
Ensure all interactive elements have explicit data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Add data-testid to every button, link, input, and interactive card.
Never use Inter, Roboto, or Poppins for headlines; use Outfit with tight tracking.
Avoid full transparent header background; use glassmorphism with backdrop-blur.
Maintain strict APCA/WCAG AA contrast ratios for all text.
